entries.justification: Category (b) — design/scope decision beyond this ops milestone. The shadcn Table wrapper (src/dashboard/src/components/ui/table.tsx:9, `<div class="relative w-full overflow-auto">`) that renders data-at-rest's findings tables has no tabIndex/role on the scrolling container, so a keyboard user cannot focus and scroll it independently of page scroll. Fixing this correctly means adding focus + ARIA landmark handling to a component shared by every table across the app (findings, identity, certificates, roadmap, etc.), which is a focus-order change with app-wide blast radius. 165-CONTEXT.md's phase boundary explicitly excludes 'keyboard-navigation or focus-order audits' from this milestone's scope. Blocker: requires a dedicated keyboard-accessibility pass across components/ui/table.tsx's consumers, not a single-route token/aria edit — tracked as follow-up work, not accepted as permanent debt. Environment addendum (Phase 177-07, 2026-09-02): all 33 a11y baselines, including this one, were generated locally on macOS on 2026-08-27 in a single batch (this file at 12:11:20 UTC), but the gate enforcing them runs on GitHub's ubuntu-latest Linux runner — different font metrics mean overflow-triggered rules like this one can be present on Linux and absent from the macOS-generated baseline, which is exactly what happened here (baseline was 0, i.e. never observed). /data-at-rest renders four <Table> instances with 9-10 wide TableHead columns each; the header row alone can overflow horizontally regardless of row count, which is why this empty-fixture variant (zero data rows) still fires the rule. Observed count 2 on GitHub Actions run 33644730813 (workflow 'Dashboard Quality', job 'Axe + Console Gate', empty-fixture step), 2026-09-02, with zero intervening changes to this page, table.tsx, or any a11y fixture since the 2026-08-27 baseline was authored. This is an environment-mismatch finding (macOS-generated baseline vs. Linux-enforced gate), not a regression — tracked as a follow-up to regenerate all baselines on a Linux CI runner, or to fix table.tsx directly so the rule zeroes app-wide.
